name: Sponsorship or naming-rights spend with no measurable promotional deliverables
description: A sponsor pays substantial amounts to a sports body, club or event but there is little evidence of advertising, activation or audience reach, or the sponsor has no relevant business.
fp: Philanthropic or owner-affiliated sponsorships and early-stage brand investment may have little measurable return.

links.name: Sponsorship or naming-rights spend with no measurable promotional deliverables
links.ctx: A newly formed company with no marketing history pays an unusually high sponsorship fee that cannot be tied to audience or exposure.
